question.text: 'Fit and Proper' criteria for Sponsor/Manager per Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008 includes:

answer.text: Integrity, reputation, financial competence, no history of restraint orders/convictions/wilful default

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 5.2.2 lists integrity, reputation, financial competence (net worth/solvency), no history of restraint orders/convictions/wilful default. **The Trap:** Narrow criteria miss the full test. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same test for brokers, DPs, etc. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Request notarised fit-and-proper declarations during DD.
